comment: The sixteen gate switches share their panel positions with the sixteen knobs: a small button is placed at the centre of each large knob (Cartesia.cpp:790), so the button is clicked at the middle and the knob round its edge. The knob values are held per layer in the module rather than in the parameters: changing layer writes the stored values back into the knobs, and at any other moment the knobs are read back into storage (Cartesia.cpp:655). The range is held down so that the minimum plus the range never passes 10V (Cartesia.cpp:501).
